name: Iterative Wavelet Thresholding for CT Reconstruction
definition: An iterative reconstruction method that solves the inverse problem $g = Af + n$ by combining a gradient descent step on the data fidelity term with a sparsity-promoting wavelet thresholding step. It is used to reconstruct images from noisy sinograms, particularly in sparse or limited angle scenarios.
summary: Iterative Wavelet Thresholding reconstructs CT images from noisy sinograms by combining gradient descent with sparsity-promoting wavelet thresholding, particularly effective in sparse or limited angle scenarios.
